headline: One picture, 318 different works
reasons: The same picture was saved as 3 different files and attached to 318 different works in 2 villages. A photo of one site cannot be evidence for 318 separate works.

The 3 files hold one picture saved more than once (for example re-compressed, resized, cut by a few pixels or with another date or GPS stamp printed on it), so their bytes differ. They were matched by comparing the pictures: every two of these files differ in at most 5 of 256 bits of a picture fingerprint (the limit is 8), and their small greyscale copies differ by at most 0.016 (the limit is 0.03).
The files (first 12 characters of each fingerprint): 01cafcf46a1f on 276 works, 6bfaaff2a2f9 on 39 works, 93413f95de12 on 3 works.
The works are recorded as: Contour Trench (317), Gullu Plug (1).
